scripts.name: validate-storage
scripts.description: Comprehensive validation tool for the storage system. Checks schema validation, referential integrity, file existence, orphan detection, ID format, date format, required fields, duplicates, version validation, and length limits across all three subsections.

scripts.name: test-edge-cases
scripts.description: Edge case and boundary testing suite for the storage system. Runs 35 tests covering malformed JSON, long descriptions, special characters, ID format violations, category mismatches, version field issues, and duplicate detection.

scripts.name: repair-storage
scripts.description: Automated repair tool for common storage system issues. Fixes versions, dates, rebuilds category indexes, removes duplicates, truncates long descriptions, and ensures structural completeness. Supports --dry-run mode.

scripts.name: grade-research
scripts.description: Evaluates research JSON quality across five dimensions: citation count/quality, coverage breadth, depth (word count), and specificity (metrics, tools, code). Outputs a graded report with recommendations.

scripts.name: merge-research
scripts.description: Merges multiple team research JSON files by topic category. Deduplicates techniques using string similarity, identifies coverage gaps across teams, and outputs a unified research document.
